task.title: Welcome empty state in sidebar when festinalente not initialized
task.description: Add a welcome/empty state to the VSCode sidebar when the .festinalente/ directory does not exist, guiding new users to initialize with npx festinalente init.
task.problem: When a user opens the VSCode extension in a project that hasn't been initialized with Festina Lente (no .festinalente/ directory), the sidebar shows nothing useful. There is no guidance on how to get started, leaving users confused about what to do next.
task.value: First-run experience matters. A clear welcome state reduces friction for new users, shows them exactly how to initialize the project, and makes the extension feel polished rather than broken when .festinalente/ doesn't exist yet.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a workspace where .festinalente/ directory does NOT exist When the user opens the Festina Lente sidebar Then a welcome state is displayed with a "FESTINA LENTE" heading And a tree item showing "Get started: npx festinalente init"
Given a workspace where .festinalente/ directory exists When the user opens the Festina Lente sidebar Then the normal kanban view is displayed as usual
Given a workspace where .festinalente/ directory does NOT exist And the user runs npx festinalente init (directory appears) When the file system watcher detects the new directory Then the sidebar automatically refreshes to show the kanban view
